faqs.subtitle: Everything you need to know about the Astro Baby app and our prenatal Garbhadhan Sanskar process.

items.q: How to start with Astro Baby Garbhadhan Sanskar?
items.a: To start using Astro Baby Garbhadhan Sanskar, simply download the 'Astro Baby' mobile application on your device from the Play Store or App Store. Enter your details for a free trial. You can then choose a plan matching your pregnancy stage.

items.q: Can I use Astro Baby on my laptop or desktop computer?
items.a: No, Astro Baby Garbhadhan Sanskar is currently a mobile and tablet application service, fully optimized for Android and iOS devices.

items.q: I am in the 5th month of my pregnancy; am I too late to start Garbhadhan Sanskar with Astro Baby?
items.a: Whether you are in your 1st month or 9th month, it is never too late to begin. Astro Baby's scientific curriculum allows late joiners to benefit immediately and access all previous months' guidance.

items.q: What makes Astro Baby Garbhadhan Sanskar unique?
items.a: Astro Baby synthesizes authentic Vedic Garbhadhan Sanskar mantras, daily audio shlokas, and Ayurvedic satvik nutrition with cutting-edge fetal neuroscience and obstetric medical guidance.
